description: Election Commission - Declare that W. A. Ranjith as Vice Chairman of Buttala Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the office of Vice Chairman of a local authority (Buttala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral procedures, nomination by a political party, and declaration of election results for a local government position, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
